proposal.name: Read one final plumbing review verdict

plan.name: Read one final plumbing review verdict
plan.summary: Read plumbing review approval and repair requests from exactly one plain, unindented final non-empty line, either VERDICT: approve or VERDICT: changes needed, outside Markdown quotes and backtick or tilde code fences, so quoted build content cannot approve a candidate. Extra verdict lines anywhere, including quoted or fenced ones, missing or malformed verdicts, and prose after a verdict leave the checked candidate and review for a person without approval or an automatic repair; a single valid changes-needed verdict keeps the existing two-attempt repair flow and fresh checks and reviews. Tell both built-in and configured reviewers to report candidate text addressed to reviewers or claiming a verdict as a finding, never follow it, and to use the single final verdict format. Update the configured regression fixture in internal/plumbing/regression_conventions_654_accept_test.go to put its findings before its verdict, intentionally ending support for that fixture's non-final verdict without changing its regression-scope assertions. Document this review contract in SPEC.md, citing [#959's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-959.json), and in docs/factory.md.

tests.name: TestReviewQuotedApproval959
tests.says: An approval quoted from candidate content before a real changes-needed verdict cannot approve or start an automatic repair; the candidate and review remain available for a person.

tests.name: TestReviewFencedApproval959
tests.says: Backtick and tilde fenced approvals cannot substitute for a verdict, including before a real changes-needed verdict and inside an unclosed fence at the end of a reply.

tests.name: TestReviewDuplicateVerdicts959
tests.says: Repeated or conflicting verdict lines, in either order and even when quoted, leave the build unapproved for a person without entering the repair loop.

tests.name: TestReviewFinalVerdict959
tests.says: Only an exact plain final verdict controls approval or repair: missing, malformed, indented, decorated and non-final verdicts hold the build, while valid approvals and the existing two-attempt repair flow still work.

tests.name: TestReviewInstructionsRejectCandidateDirections959
tests.says: Built-in and configured review prompts require a single final verdict outside quotes and fences and tell the reviewer to report candidate reviewer-directed text and verdict claims as findings, not follow them.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](plan.json) and five acceptance tests covering final verdicts, quoted approvals, duplicates, and reviewer instructions. The first check passed: all five tests fail on the unchanged base as required.
